summary: Two backcountry skiers snowmobiled into the Buffalo Pass area and were skiing in the North Fork of Fish Creek drainage when one triggered an avalanche around 12:20 pm; the caught skier, Andrew Hyde, 49, of Steamboat Springs, came to rest against a tree and was not breathing when his companion reached him. The companion performed CPR for close to an hour while Routt County sheriff's deputies, Routt County SAR, and Classic Air responded; CPR was unsuccessful and Classic Air evacuated the surviving skier by helicopter.
location: North Fork of Fish Creek drainage, Buffalo Pass
responding_agency: Routt County Sheriff's Office; Routt County Search and Rescue; Classic Air
notes: CAIC-reported avalanche; 2022-03-19 was a Saturday per story. Uninjured companion not counted in victims per the companion convention (cf. id 1551).
